rules.name: Long Single-Line Lua Code
rules.description: Extremely long single lines of Lua code often indicate obfuscated or packed scripts.
rules.recommendation: Manually deobfuscate and inspect the code.

rules.name: Base64 Encoded String
rules.description: Contains a Base64-encoded string that may hide malicious payloads.
rules.recommendation: Decode the Base64 string and inspect its contents.

rules.name: Hexadecimal String Payload
rules.description: Contains a long hexadecimal string that may encode hidden data or payloads.
rules.recommendation: Decode the hex string and inspect its contents.

rules.name: Obfuscated Variable Names
rules.description: Contains many single-character or randomly named variables, suggesting obfuscation.
rules.recommendation: Review the script for hidden functionality.

rules.name: String.char() Obfuscation
rules.description: Uses string.char() with numeric values to hide string content from static analysis.
rules.recommendation: Evaluate the constructed string to inspect hidden content.

rules.name: String.byte() Obfuscation
rules.description: Uses string.byte() to obscure string comparison operations.

rules.name: Escape-Heavy String Literal
rules.description: Contains strings with excessive escape sequences, often used to hide code.
rules.recommendation: Decode the escape sequences and inspect the resulting string.

rules.name: Nested Function Wrapping
rules.description: Deeply nested function calls often indicate layered obfuscation.
rules.recommendation: Manually unwrap and analyze the nested functions.

rules.name: Lua Bytecode Header
rules.description: File starts with Lua bytecode signature. Pre-compiled bytecode hides source and is suspicious.
rules.recommendation: Do not run. Decompile and inspect the bytecode.

rules.name: XOR Decode Loop
rules.description: Contains an XOR decoding loop, commonly used to decrypt hidden payloads.
rules.recommendation: Manually decode the XOR payload and inspect its contents.
